node.label: Elaine Tyler May
node.date_label: Great Expectations (1980) · Homeward Bound (1988) · America and the Pill (2010)
node.description: A social historian who connects domestic life to political culture in Cold War America. Her interview explains how employment limits, public policy, consumer expectations and security fears helped shape family ideals, without making the ideal identical to lived experience.
